# @scramjet/logger

This package is part of Scramjet Transform Hub. The package provides a simple logger with 100% Console Web API compatible signatures and a streaming output of any choice.

## Install

```bash
npm install @scramjet/logger
```

## Import

```typescript
import { /* ... */ } from "@scramjet/logger";
```

See the [package docs](../../docs-source/README.md) for full documentation.
